content: The ACC 2010 schedule outlines the coordination of interviews and presentations during the conference, which will take place at the Atlanta Marriott Downtown, located at 160 Spring Street, Atlanta, GA 30303. Filming is scheduled from Saturday, March 13, to Tuesday, March 16, 2010. Dr. Gibson is available for interviews during times marked in black, while times marked in green indicate his unavailability for interviews, though discussions or presentations on topics can still proceed. Saturday, March 13, 2010 At 10:15 AM, Dr. Robert M. Califf will discuss the NAVIGATOR Trial, which investigates the effects of nateglinide and valsartan on outcomes in patients with impaired glucose tolerance. At 11:00 AM, Dr. Manesh R. Patel will be interviewed. At 4:30 PM, Dr. Hyo-Soo Kim will present findings from the CILON-T study, a randomized trial evaluating the efficacy of cilostazol-based triple antiplatelet therapy in reducing ischemic complications after drug-eluting stent implantation for coronary heart disease. Sunday, March 14, 2010 At 11:00 AM, Dr. Mark Chan will present a 15-year analysis of clinical trials in non-ST elevation acute coronary syndromes, highlighting how more aggressive treatments have maintained similar mortality rates despite higher-risk patient profiles. At 11:30 AM, Dr. Freek W. A. Verheugt will present. At 12:30 PM, Dr. Tracy Y. Wang will discuss the EARLY ACS trial, focusing on the safety and efficacy of early eptifibatide use in acute coronary syndrome patients who received upfront clopidogrel. At 1:00 PM, Dr. Chiara Melloni will present data on the safety and efficacy of adjusted-dose eptifibatide in acute coronary syndrome patients with reduced renal function. At 2:00 PM, Dr. Francois Schiele will discuss a propensity score-matched analysis of gender differences in outcomes after acute myocardial infarction, considering clinical characteristics and treatments. At 2:30 PM, Dr. Michael Maeng will present 18-month follow-up results from the SORT OUT III trial, comparing zotarolimus-eluting and sirolimus-eluting coronary stents in an all-comer population. At 3:00 PM, Dr. Michael D. Ezekowitz will discuss a randomized trial evaluating three doses of the long-acting oral direct Factor Xa inhibitor betrixaban in patients with atrial fibrillation. At 3:30 PM, Dr. Gary Michael Felker will present findings from the DOSE study, a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial investigating diuretic strategies in acute decompensated heart failure. At 4:00 PM, Dr. George H. Crossley III will discuss the impact of remote monitoring with automatic clinician notifications on the clinical care of ICD and CRT-D patients. At 5:00 PM, Dr. Henry Ginsberg will present results from the ACCORD Lipid Study, which evaluated the effects of combination lipid therapy on cardiovascular events in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus. Monday, March 15, 2010 At 8:00 AM, Dr. Rhonda M. At 8:30 AM, Dr. Peter Clemmensen will discuss three-year follow-up results from the DEDICATION trial, comparing drug-eluting stents to bare-metal stents in ST-elevation myocardial infarction patients. At 9:00 AM, Dr. Robert A. Byrne will present two-year clinical and angiographic outcomes from a randomized trial comparing a polymer-free dual drug-eluting stent to polymer-based Cypher and Endeavor drug-eluting stents. At 9:30 AM, Dr. Steven Goldman will discuss a randomized trial comparing radial artery grafts to saphenous vein grafts in coronary artery bypass surgery, as part of the VA Cooperative Study. At 10:00 AM, Dr. Ted Feldman will present the primary safety and efficacy endpoints of the EVEREST II randomized clinical trial. At 10:20 AM, Dr. Claes Held will discuss results from the PLATO trial, comparing ticagrelor to clopidogrel in acute coronary syndrome patients undergoing coronary artery bypass surgery. At 2:15 PM, Dr. William C. At 2:30 PM, Dr. Robert S. Epstein will discuss the results of the MM-WES study, which examined the impact of genotyping warfarin patients on clinical outcomes. At 3:30 PM, Dr. Hisao Ogawa will present. At 4:00 PM, Dr. Hisao Ogawa will discuss the evaluation of endothelial function using Endo-PAT. Tuesday, March 16, 2010 At 9:30 AM, Dr. David Antoniucci will present findings from the Jetstent Trial, a randomized comparison of Angiojet rheolytic thrombectomy before direct infarct artery stenting versus direct stenting alone in patients with acute myocardial infarction.
